sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We appreciate your updated volume forecasts and your willingness to agree to shorter payment terms.
Building on your proposal for 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, our colleagues will address this separately.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued interest and have reviewed the additional data you provided regarding delivery rates and historical prices. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While we acknowledge these records, they do not directly impact the pricing structure for this specific part, and volume adjustments have already been fully factored into our previous offer. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our current defect rate for you is about 80 ppm.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Our offer is a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Building on your preferred terms of a 14-day payment period and a 24-month contract, we can offer a further revised price of €5.44 per unit. This option features a price of €5.44 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
